title: OpenPIA evidence slot catalogue (A55)
description: The evidence slot catalogue: every slot code with its capture guidance and per-context requirements across both notices. A conditional slot carries a machine-readable `when` object — { field, op, value } under a closed grammar — naming the schema field, comparison (equals or not_equals), and enum value that make the slot apply.
